author: Graf Technology, LLC
description: A Hubitat driver for ntfy push notifications (ntfy.sh or self-hosted). Access token or basic auth, connection testing, input validation, status attributes, tags/emojis, click actions, attachments, custom icons, markdown formatting, message scheduling and self-signed certificate support.
releaseNotes: v1.1.0: Access token (Bearer) authentication; 'Ignore SSL certificate errors' option for self-signed certificates; fixed 'Send at Specific Time' scheduling (the date was previously ignored); credentials are no longer written to debug logs; Test Connection no longer inherits scheduling delays; saving preferences keeps status history; debug logging auto-disables after 30 minutes; topic no longer defaults to the shared public 'hubitat' topic (existing devices still using it on ntfy.sh get a log warning: change it to something unique); stricter validation with clearer error messages; automated test suite and CI.
